author: marioevz
content: I was reviewing the EIP-8141 PR in EELS and found out that `APPROVE` still works under `STATICCALL`, which might seem obvious since the EIP treats `APPROVE` as exemptible from this flag, but I feel that breaks the assumption that nothing can be modified under `STATICCALL`, doesn't it?
